claims.content: Among the SPRINT participants, targeting systolic blood pressure below 120 mm Hg rather than below 140 mm Hg reduced the rate of the prespecified primary cardiovascular composite outcome.
Among the SPRINT participants, intensive blood-pressure treatment reduced all-cause mortality relative to standard treatment during the reported follow-up.
Intensive treatment increased several serious adverse events, including hypotension, syncope, electrolyte abnormalities, and acute kidney injury or failure.
